description: This file defines a UI component named 'CheckoutModal' for a furniture shopping application's frontend, built using the LightningJS framework. It manages the modal dialog's state, layout, and interactions, including form fields for user details, order summary, and action buttons.

classes.name: CheckoutModal
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a checkout modal dialog with form inputs, summary, and action buttons.

methods.name: focusName
methods.description: Sets the focus state to the name input field.

methods.name: focusEmail
methods.description: Sets the focus state to the email input field.

methods.name: focusAddress
methods.description: Sets the focus state to the address input field.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the checkout modal by invoking the store's closeCheckout method.

methods.name: place
methods.description: Handles order placement, ensuring form fields are filled, then calls the store's placeOrder method with user details.
